name: Rivaaj Mahal Charcoal Shampoo + Conditioner 2-in-1 | Black Shine Formula
description:
Rivaaj Mahal Charcoal Shampoo + Conditioner is a dual-action 2-in-1 formula that cleanses and conditions hair simultaneously. Infused with activated charcoal, it removes dirt, oil, and impurities while nourishing strands for soft, smooth, and manageable hair. This time-saving formula enhances natural dark tones, giving hair a healthy black shine. Suitable for all hair types, it provides long-lasting freshness and salon-like results in a single wash.
Key Features
 2-in-1 formula combining shampoo and conditioner
 Activated charcoal detoxifies scalp and removes buildup
 Enhances natural black shine for radiant hair
 Cleanses and nourishes hair for softness and manageability
 Quick and convenient time-saving hair care
 Suitable for all hair types and daily use
How to Use
 Apply to wet hair and massage gently
 Leave for 2–3 minutes for better absorption
 Rinse thoroughly and repeat if needed
Material
Hair-safe active ingredients, activated charcoal, conditioning agents
Safety Information
 For external use only
 Avoid contact with eyes
 Keep out of reach of children
 Discontinue use if irritation occurs
Package Includes
 1 × Rivaaj Mahal Charcoal Shampoo + Conditioner 2-in-1
